# ECN-2026-009 - Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Reason for change
-----------------
Background: During routine maintenance and a targeted reliability review of the Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01), maintenance staff identified inconsistent clamp behavior on the mandrel assembly. Investigation cross-referenced the maintenance manual MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 and operational procedure SOP-P1-L2-03. The investigation determined that a clarification and formal change to the mandrel clamp fastener requirement is necessary to ensure consistent clamp preload, reduce cycle variation, and prevent premature wear of the mandrel clamp components.

Change rationale: The change standardizes the fastening requirement for the mandrel clamp bolt on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 to eliminate ambiguity that led to variable manual torqueing practices. Standardization reduces maintenance error, improves repeatability of radial positioning, and aligns field practice with the design intent captured during commissioning. This ECN updates the documented torque requirement and prescribes implementation and verification steps for maintenance and operations personnel.

Affected items
--------------
- Technical documentation: Update MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 to incorporate the standardized mandrel clamp bolt torque specification and to add the verification checklist reference.  
- Operating procedure: Update SOP-P1-L2-03 to reflect the mandated verification step after clamp torqueing and to include the acceptance criteria language that references inspection records.  
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01 mandrel clamp bolt fastening practice; maintenance and inspection regimes for the mandrel clamp assembly.  
- Spare parts handling: Include inspection and re-torque verification when installing replacement mandrel clamp bolts or housing components, and document in parts installation records.

Implementation
--------------
Scope: This change applies to all maintenance actions affecting the mandrel clamp of EQ-P1-L2-RR01 and to any operation that requires removal and reinstallation of the mandrel or its clamp bolt. It is effective immediately upon approval.

Mandatory specification: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m. This value is to be used for all reassembly and verification activities for the mandrel clamp bolt on EQ-P1-L2-RR01.

Work steps:
- Before applying torque, consult MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 for bolt condition acceptance criteria and replacement guidance.  
- Use a calibrated torque tool capable of achieving the required value and record the tool serial number on the maintenance record. Calibration traceability must be recorded per the existing calibration program referenced in MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.  
- Apply torque to the mandrel clamp bolt to the specified value of 395 N·m. Follow the tightening sequence and technique documented in MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.  
- After torque application, perform the verification checks required by SOP-P1-L2-03, including functional clamp engagement and a run-in check under the conditions described in SOP-P1-L2-03. Record observations and any deviations.  
- If replacement of the clamp bolt or related clamp components occurred, attach the part change note to the maintenance record and reference MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 for installation acceptance criteria.

Examples and expected outcomes:
- Example A: During a scheduled bearing housing replacement on EQ-P1-L2-RR01, the mandrel clamp bolt was removed. Reassembly followed the procedure above and the bolt was torqued to 395 N·m. Post-assembly verification per SOP-P1-L2-03 showed no axial movement and acceptable concentricity without additional adjustment. Record indicated no unusual vibration during initial production cycles.  
- Example B: A field incident where the bolt had been torqued using an uncalibrated tool resulted in a loose clamp. After rework and application of 395 N·m with a calibrated tool, clamp performance returned to expected parameters. The maintenance record documented the torque value, tool ID, and post-torque verification results.

Records to keep
----------------
- Maintenance action record: Include equipment tag EQ-P1-L2-RR01, description of action, technician name, tool serial number, applied torque value 395 N·m, and verification outcome. Attach any photograph evidence of torque tool reading and clamp assembly orientation.  
- Calibration record: Maintain calibration certificate for the torque tool used; reference in the maintenance action record.  
- Inspection checklist: Update and retain the checklist per SOP-P1-L2-03 and file with the work order history for EQ-P1-L2-RR01.  
- Change trace: Record ECN-2026-009 in the equipment history log and note linkage to ECN-2026-041 where applicable.  
All records must be filed in the document control system under the equipment history for EQ-P1-L2-RR01 and be retrievable for audits aligned to MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.

Training and communication
--------------------------
- Briefing: Conduct a targeted briefing for maintenance and operations teams covering the new mandatory torque requirement and updated verification steps. Reference MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 for technical details and SOP-P1-L2-03 for operational checks.  
- Competency: Only personnel trained on the updated procedure and authorized to use calibrated torque tools shall perform the torque application and verification.

Approvals
---------
- The change requires documented approval from the plant maintenance manager and the operations manager for P1, line P1-L2. Signatures and dates shall be recorded on the ECN approval page and stored with the ECN file.  
- Post-implementation review will reference ECN-2026-041 for related system changes and to confirm that the updates in MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 and SOP-P1-L2-03 have been completed and published.  
- A one-time verification audit will be scheduled following implementation to confirm records and to validate that the mandated torque value of 395 N·m has been consistently applied and recorded.

Related documents
-----------------
ECN-2026-041  
MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1  
SOP-P1-L2-03
